welcome: Questions are shown in Italian — exactly as they appear in the exam. Answer VERO or FALSO. Anything you get wrong comes back later until it sticks.
disclaimer: ⚠️ A study aid, not an official ministry product. Defer to your autoscuola.
payments_not_live: Payments aren't live yet — the bot is in closed testing. Message /support if you'd like access.
stats_empty: You haven't answered anything yet. Open the app to start.
help: How it works The questions are in the app: open it with the button below or from the menu. /stats — your statistics /plan — your subscription /settings — language and translation /privacy — what data we keep /delete — delete my data
privacy: Your data We store your Telegram ID and your answer history. No name, no username, no message text. /delete erases everything, permanently.
delete_confirm: Erase all your data? Your answer history and progress will be gone permanently.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
study_in_app: The questions live in the app now. Open it to practise — stats and your subscription stay here.
plan_perks: Included: the question translated into your language, and an explanation grounded in the Codice della Strada.
error_transient: The service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
plan_trial_note: When the trial ends the subscription renews automatically at the price of the plan you chose. You can cancel any time before then in @tribute and nothing will be charged.
plan_free_body: You have all 7106 questions, exam mode and practice. Translations and explanations are Premium.
plan_granted_note: Full access until this date. Nothing will be charged.
delete_paid_warning: ⚠️ You have an active subscription. Deleting your data destroys it too, and it cannot be restored — a refund has to be arranged through @tribute. If you only wanted to clear your progress, use Start over in the app's settings.
